cases.description: Aa changes the count: TX-01 (Mark equals 's10', Aa off) then turning Aa on gives TX-02
manualSteps: Tick only the Architectural link. Filter tab: + New filter, Categories Doors, + Condition Mark equals s10: count 1.
Turn Aa on in that rule: count 0.

cases.description: The top connector set to OR builds GR-02 (Mark equals S10 OR Swing Angle undefined)
manualSteps: Tick only the Architectural link. Filter tab: + New filter, Categories Doors, + Condition Mark equals S10, + Condition Swing Angle undefined.
Click the connector until it reads OR: count 12.

cases.description: Build NU-04 in the panel (the picker takes Swing Angle, the count equals NU-04), save it as a custom filter, switch to a new filter, switch back: the saved filter reloads with the same count; the test deletes it
cases.expected: parameter 'Swing Angle'; NU-04 expected, and again after reload
manualSteps: Tick only the Architectural link. Build NU-04 (Doors, Swing Angle equals 90°): count 130.
The parameter box reads Swing Angle. Rename it (pencil), Save, then + New filter (Discard if asked).
Pick the saved filter in the source list: count 130 again. Delete it with the trash button.

cases.description: Live pauses above 5,000 matches: every category in the Architectural link (SC-02) keeps the Live switch on and shows the line 'Paused: over 5,000 matches'; None clears it
cases.expected: count = SC-02 expected; Live switch on; paused line shown; no line after None
manualSteps: Tick only the Architectural link. Filter tab: + New filter, open Categories, click All.
The count reads 7,526. The Live switch stays on with its label Live, and the line under the count reads 'Paused: over 5,000 matches'. The Revit selection did not change.
Click None: the count reads 0 and the line is gone.

cases.description: T1 from the panel: the eye on the Architectural link row hides the link, the temporary bar shows one change, Reset removes the bar
cases.expected: temporary bar '1 change', then no bar after Reset
manualSteps: Explorer tab, Scope 'Whole model', Architectural link ticked: click the eye on the link's model row.
The linked building disappears in the active view and the temporary bar reads 1 change.
Click Reset: the link is back and the bar is gone.

cases.description: T3 from the panel: the eye on Doors under the Architectural link hides the linked doors through Hide in View, the temporary bar shows one change, Reset shows them again
cases.expected: eye Hidden and temporary bar '1 change', then eye Shown and no bar after Reset
manualSteps: Make {3D} the active view. Explorer tab, Scope 'Whole model', Architectural link ticked: click Collapse all, expand the link's row, click the eye on its Doors row.
The linked doors disappear in the view, the eye on Doors is off and the temporary bar reads 1 change. In Revit, Reveal Hidden Elements shows the doors as hidden in the view.
Click Reset: the doors are back, the eye is on and the bar is gone.
